title: Luxury dive watches
intro: New dive watches from UK authorised retailers, grouped by case size so you can go straight to a 40mm or 42mm diver, from everyday swimming watches to professional-grade divers. Check the water-resistance rating and whether the bezel is unidirectional before you buy.

title: Luxury chronographs
intro: Chronographs add a stopwatch to the time, operated by pushers beside the crown. Mechanical chronographs are among the most complex movements in watchmaking and cost more to service than three-hand watches.

title: Luxury ladies' watches
intro: Luxury watches listed by the retailer as ladies' models, typically smaller cases and often set with diamonds or mother-of-pearl dials. Case size is personal, so compare diameters rather than labels.

title: Luxury men's watches
intro: Luxury watches listed by the retailer as men's models. Fit depends on lug-to-lug length as much as diameter, so check both against your wrist before ordering online.

title: Skeleton and openwork watches
intro: Skeleton and openwork watches cut away the dial and movement plates so you can see the mechanism at work. Legibility varies widely, so look closely at the hands against the movement.

title: 18k gold and platinum watches
intro: Watches whose retailer listing names 18-carat gold (18k or 18ct) or platinum, either as the whole case or combined with steel or titanium. Gold-plated and gold PVD watches are left out. Precious metal is heavier and softer than steel, and it moves the price more than any other single feature.

title: Diamond watches
intro: Watches set with diamonds on the dial, bezel or case. The retailer's listing gives the details of the setting where it is supplied.

title: Limited-edition watches
intro: Watches the retailer lists as limited editions, made in a fixed number. Stock of a limited edition does not come back once it sells out.

title: Luxury watches under £3,000
intro: New watches from £2,000 to £3,000 at UK authorised retailers. This band is where most buyers make their first step into Swiss mechanical watchmaking.

title: Luxury watches from £3,000 to £5,000
intro: New watches from £3,000 to £5,000 at UK authorised retailers, where in-house movements, chronometer certification and precious-metal details start to appear.

title: Luxury watches from £5,000 to £10,000
intro: New watches from £5,000 to £10,000 at UK authorised retailers. Check the warranty length and the brand's published service cost before you buy at this level.

title: Luxury watches from £10,000 to £15,000
intro: New watches from £10,000 to £15,000 at UK authorised retailers, including gold cases and complications.

title: Luxury watches over £15,000
intro: New watches from £15,000 at UK authorised retailers, including haute horlogerie complications and precious metals. At this level, check your home insurance covers the watch before it arrives.
